verdict.rationale: The docs say Computer can process image files and that users can upload files up to 200 MB. That implies users can share screenshots and photos, but it never says the assistant visually interprets or understands what is in them, as opposed to manipulating them with code. missing for 10: explicit documentation of visual understanding of screenshots and photos, any claim or evidence of interpretation accuracy, a documented image-sharing flow for screenshots, independent or hands-on corroboration.
